# Canvink

> Canvink is an open-source, local-first notebook for handwriting, freeform text, images, and PDF previews on one canvas.

## Product facts

- Category: local-first mixed-media notebook
- Current status: public alpha
- Canvas: pressure-aware ink, text, checklists, images, and PDF previews
- Page modes: free canvas and printable A4
- Browser demo: stores notebook data only in the current browser
- Desktop builds: use local SQLite notebook storage
- Accounts: no account is required for the local web demo
- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later

## Primary links

- Product: https://canvink.vercel.app/
- Local web demo: https://canvink.vercel.app/app
- Source: https://github.com/arturict/canvink
- Releases: https://github.com/arturict/canvink/releases
